10 minutes per round (plus the wait until the next round)

Monthly event in Darashia: {npc:Casper} gives you a {item:Shapechanger} that disguises you as a random creature, and you have to run to the right teleport before time runs out, over eight increasingly fast cycles. Those who reach the end get a {item:Shapeshifter Ring} and a {item:Reward Box}, and if the server wins enough rounds everyone gets 20% more respawn temporarily.
Test your ability in a challenge of ingenuity and agility. Will your world be richly blessed, or will you leave Kurik unimpressed?
It only happens between the **20th and 25th of each month**, except in March, September and October (and it does not start if a World Quest is active or starting that day).

Put the {item:Shapechanger} on a hotkey: every second counts.
Use every speed item and spell you have ({spell:Haste}, {item:Time Ring}, {item:Boots of Haste}).
During the challenge nothing can harm you; the only danger is {creature:Wasp|Wasps} and {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads} that someone has lured near the entrance.

During the event there is a new round **every four hours** (counted from the Server Save). Each round is announced 15 minutes beforehand with the message *"The darashian journey will begin in 15 minutes!"*.

Go to the **north** of Darashia and go down the stairs **twice** at this spot. If you are not in Darashia, take a boat or carpet there (say {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} to the captain or the carpet pilot). {npc:Casper}'s room is 2 floors down.
Location of the entrance north of Darashia
In the room are {npc:Casper}, two books with the event instructions and several creature dummies. Say {key:hi} and {key:change} to Casper to receive a {item:Shapechanger}.
Casper only gives you **one** Shapechanger ever. Do not lose it.
Stay in the room and wait for the event to start. When it starts you are automatically teleported to the challenge area.

As soon as you are teleported, use the {item:Shapechanger}. You are disguised as one of these creatures: {creature:Lost Soul}, a {wiki:Pharaohs|Pharaoh} without clothes, {creature:Carniphila}, {creature:Quara Hydromancer}, {creature:Blightwalker}, {creature:Mutated Rat}, {creature:Zombie} or {creature:Nightstalker}.
Go to the teleport of the creature you turned into. Next to each teleport there is a dummy identical to those in Casper's room that shows which disguise it belongs to.
The dummies show the teleport for each disguise
The challenge room, with transformation squares and Slime Puddles
The transformation squares and the {wiki:Paralysis|paralysis} from the {item:Slime Puddle|Slime Puddles} slow you down. Use mana potions to cancel the paralysis and speed items/spells.
If you enter the right teleport in time, you go to a smaller room where you wait for the next cycle. If you fail, you are out of this round.

Repeat: use the Shapechanger and run to the right teleport. There are **seven more cycles** after the first, each with less time. If you get through all eight cycles, you win the round for the whole server and are taken to the rewards room.
Of the event's 30 rounds, the server has to win a certain number to win the whole event.
In the rewards room, open the chest to receive the {item:Shapeshifter Ring}.
Another view of the rewards room
Go up to {npc:Casper} and say {key:hi} and {key:reward}. You receive a {item:Reward Box}, which may contain {item:Chameleon Rune|Chameleon Runes} or a {item:Time Ring}.
To return to the surface, climb the same stairs **twice** up to the entry point, north of Darashia.
If you manage to do **all the disguises** of the {item:Shapechanger} during the event, you earn the **Master Shapeshifter** achievement.
If the server wins enough rounds, the whole world gets a temporary 20% respawn increase.
Dates: 20th to 25th of each month, except March, September and October.
